name: chatos-web-design-studio
description: Design and refine editable websites with an AI-aware visual canvas.

interface.longDescription: A visual website design workbench where users can drag, resize, style, annotate, and ask AI to update selected components through a shared structured design document.
capabilities: Visual website canvas
Categorized searchable library with 20 production website components
Responsive finished sections for navigation, hero, features, pricing, FAQ, contact, and footer
Drag and resize components
Component-level annotations
Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts
Layer ordering, locking, visibility, alignment, undo, and redo
Hierarchical layers, multi-selection, grouping, snapping guides, and grouped dragging
Container Flex row, Flex column, and Grid auto layout
Multiple pages with page duplication and isolated component trees
Image asset import and reusable asset library
Component-tree copy and paste across pages
Standalone responsive HTML export
Reusable component library with cross-page instances
Reusable component instance synchronization with content, style, and frame overrides
Global color, radius, and typography design tokens
Multi-page route preview
Component click interactions for page navigation and external URLs
Single-file routed React component export
Single-file routed Vue component export
AI-editable structured documents
Revision-safe focused patches
defaultPrompt: Create an editable landing page for my product.
Apply the pending component notes to this design.
Improve the selected section while preserving the rest.

permissions.reason: Launch the installed Web Design Studio MCP and local application service.
Export design documents and generated website files.
